status: draft — pending trade-expert sign-off (P1 exit test)

rules.pass_thresholds: Read from the pinned QP file (never hard-coded) — see qp.json minimum_aggregate_passing_percent and per-NOS marks.
rules.critical_pc: level < 2 → that NOS cannot be marked competent, regardless of overall NOS %.
rules.scope: Anchors cover every PC of the 5 task-evidenced NOS only (CON/N9001, CON/N0602, CON/N0604, CON/N0603, CON/N0605). CON/N8001, CON/N8002 and DGT/VSQ/N0101 are declaration+notes only in the MVP and are out of rubric scope — see tasks.json.not_task_evidenced_nos.
rules.marks_note: PC marks are the official per-element practical marks from the QP v4.0 PDF, split EQUALLY across the PCs in that element (the PDF does not publish a per-PC split — CSDCI leaves this to the assessment body). This equal split is an MVP simplification to be reviewed by the trade expert; the per-NOS and per-element totals themselves are verbatim from the PDF.
rules.disclaimer: MVP assessor-support rubric; not an official SSC scoring replacement.
rules.official_status: This rubric is an MVP assessor-support tool built for this project. It is not issued, endorsed, or reviewed by CSDCI/NCVET/NSQC, and its PC marks/anchors are not an official SSC scoring scheme (see rules.marks_note for the specific equal-split simplification). Nothing it produces is an official pass/fail or certification decision.

output_contract.purpose: Two separate axes. Axis 1 (this file, pack-design-time, same for every assessment): which EVIDENCE PATHWAY exists for a PC in the fixed T1-T5 structure. Axis 2 (assessment-time, per real submitted evidence, P2/P6 scope -- not yet implemented, this is the contract for it): what the assessor actually recorded for THIS worker's THIS submission. A PC being on the TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY is NOT proof it was demonstrated -- it only means an assessor CAN judge it from T1-T5 evidence if that evidence shows it.

axis_1_pathway.TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY: PC is linked to >=1 of T1-T5 (tasks.json linked_pcs). An assessor MAY score it 0-3 from captured evidence -- IF that evidence actually shows it (see axis 2).
axis_1_pathway.DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE: PC belongs to CON/N8001, CON/N8002 or DGT/VSQ/N0101. Self-declaration + up to 3 assessor questions only. Never enters axis 2 at all -- there is no 0-3 score to withhold or grant.
axis_1_pathway.NOT_ASSESSED_IN_MVP: No pathway at all. Must be empty for the pinned pack.

axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.applies_to: TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY PCs only, recorded per assessment (not per pack)
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.DEMONSTRATED: Assessor reviewed the submitted T1-T5 evidence and it clearly shows this PC; scored 0-3 against rubric.json anchors.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.NOT_OBSERVABLE: PC is on the TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY and evidence was submitted for that task, but it does not show this specific PC (bad angle, skipped step, too short, etc). No score; drives a reassessment request (see master plan Fig.5), not a 0.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP: PC's mvp_applicability is NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP (axis-1 pack data) -- pre-set, not assessor-judged per submission, because no evidence setup could ever show it in this MVP. Never scored, never requested for reassessment.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.required_api_distinction: Any profile/report/API output MUST render these as 4 visibly distinct categories, never collapsed into one score list: demonstrated (axis2=DEMONSTRATED), declaration-only (axis1=DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE), not-observable (axis2=NOT_OBSERVABLE), not-applicable (axis2=NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP / axis1 mvp_applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP).

output_contract.wording_rule: No UI, API response, or generated report may use 'certified', 'official pass', or 'official certificate'. Use 'NSQF-aligned competency profile and assessor recommendation'.
